modules.name: alea
modules.description: Add a random module to your rack.

modules.name: interea
modules.description: Turns one V/oct input into a chord, with selectable quality, voicing and inversion.

modules.name: cumuli
modules.description: Accumulator with up and down gates and rates.

modules.name: deinde
modules.description: Quad cascading addressable attack-hold envelope.

modules.name: pavo
modules.description: Spreads a polyphonic mono signal across the stereo field (Splay UGen).

modules.name: limen
modules.description: TCP + JSON server for controlling Rack from external tools.

modules.name: MMCCCXCIX
modules.description: PT2399 delay chip emulation with feedback send/return loop.

modules.name: scando
modules.description: Scanned-synthesis oscillator: a vibrating mass-spring string scanned into an evolving wavetable.

modules.name: pellicula
modules.description: Exploded 8-voice drum sampler: every voice's sample, pitch, decay and level on its own knob and CV.

modules.name: dræn
modules.description: Drone synthesizer: two banks of 37 engines, each played from just a fundamental and a level.

modules.name: rete
modules.description: Feedback integrator network: eight leaky nodes in a random mixing matrix, self-oscillating chaos.

modules.name: ululo
modules.description: Feedback guitar: six comb strings and a saturating amp in a howling loop.

modules.name: tabes
modules.description: Disintegration looper: a tape loop that degrades a little more on every pass, with overdub.

modules.name: lustro
modules.description: Scanned filter: scando's mass-spring string drives the band gains of a 16-band resonant filterbank.

modules.name: bulla
modules.description: Inspired by Hordijk's Blippoo Box: cross-modulating oscillators and runglers, pattern and chaos.

modules.name: perge
modules.description: Stereo dynamic sampler and multi-effect: gated repeats, freeze, glitch (AC noises CONTINUA homage).

modules.name: vorax
modules.description: Feedback drone synthesizer: a self-exciting Karplus-Strong string (Audrey II port).

modules.name: textor
modules.description: One-knob loop weaver: two seconds of audio, rewoven at every turn (Fieldtone Weaver clone).

modules.name: imber
modules.description: Generative rain: eight players on a 2D field where position is routing, over a self-generated bank.

modules.name: sylla
modules.description: Random sample generator and player: ever-new procedural samples from 27 selectable engines, nothing from disk.

modules.name: guttur
modules.description: Chaotic resonator drone: a Duffing oscillator through 48 resonant filters (Gutter Synthesis port).

modules.name: vespae
modules.description: Wasp filter: the EDP Wasp / Doepfer A-124 CMOS state-variable filter, LP/BP/HP/notch at once.

modules.name: quadrare
modules.description: Patchable Walsh-Hadamard codec: sliders and jacks reach inside the transform domain.

modules.name: vestigia
modules.description: Stereo memory effect: a tape loop that recalls, degrades and eventually forgets.

modules.name: antrum
modules.description: Erbe-Verb style feedback delay network reverb: coffin to heavens, all of it modulatable.
